subject: afrikaans-fal
description: Afrikaans First Additional Language (CAPS Foundation Phase, Grades 1-3) consolidated question bank. TUTORING-FIRST model (not testing): every skill targets 20+ items; a learner works through the whole set; a wrong answer triggers Ruby reteaching (show the memo) and re-queues that item later (reteach_on_error + complete_when='all_items_correct_once'); nothing blocks and there is no pass/streak gate. Per-skill fields: gate (NONE), complete_when, reteach_on_error, target_item_count (20), caps_term, sensitive, templates, recovery_strategy, questions[]. SCHEMA per question: ref, question (English instruction shown on screen), ruby_prompt (friendly English voiceover), audio (Afrikaans text the engine speaks aloud — present on listening/phonics items), context (optional note), image_refs (optional array of image keys from afrikaans-image-manifest.md, for image-match), input_type (choice|true-false|image-match|sequence|text|cloze), options, expected, memo (English explanation/reteach shown after), error_signals, difficulty (1-3). FAL pedagogy: instructions/hints in English (home language), target content in Afrikaans.

questions.question: What does 'gelukkig' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: The describing word 'gelukkig' — what does it mean?

questions.question: What does 'vinnig' mean?
questions.ruby_prompt: The how-word 'vinnig' — what does it mean?
questions.memo: 'vinnig' means 'fast'. 'Die hond hardloop vinnig' = 'The dog runs fast'.

questions.question: Finish: 'Die seun is ___.' (The boy is happy)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which describing word means 'happy'? Die seun is ___.
questions.memo: 'gelukkig' means 'happy': 'Die seun is gelukkig' (The boy is happy).

questions.question: Which picture shows 'die groot hond' (the big dog)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'die groot hond'. Tap the right picture.
questions.memo: 'groot' = big. This is the big dog.

questions.question: Which picture shows 'die klein hond' (the small dog)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Read it: 'die klein hond'. Tap the right picture.
questions.memo: 'klein' = small. This is the small dog.

questions.question: Finish: 'Die kat is ___.' (The cat is small)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'small'? Die kat is ___.
questions.memo: 'klein' means 'small': 'Die kat is klein' (The cat is small).

questions.question: 'Die hond hardloop ___.' Which word means he runs FAST?
questions.memo: 'vinnig' means 'fast/quickly': 'Die hond hardloop vinnig' (The dog runs fast).

questions.question: Finish: 'Die meisie is ___.' (The girl is happy)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word means 'happy'? Die meisie is ___.
questions.memo: 'bly' means 'happy': 'Die meisie is bly' (The girl is happy).

questions.question: 'Praat sag' means 'Talk ___'. Which word?
questions.memo: 'sag' means 'soft/softly': 'Praat sag' = 'Talk softly'. The opposite is 'hard' (loudly).

AF.G2.LUI.01.title: Volg opeenvolgende instruksies (follow consecutive instructions)
AF.G2.LUI.01.description: Respond to two short consecutive Afrikaans instructions.
AF.G2.LUI.01.recovery_strategy: Replay and break into one step at a time. Confirm the first step before the second.

questions.question: What two things were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to both steps, then choose.
questions.audio: Trek 'n sirkel. Kleur dit rooi in.
options: Draw a circle, then colour it red
Draw a square, then colour it blue
Colour a circle, then draw a line
questions.expected: Draw a circle, then colour it red
questions.memo: 'Trek 'n sirkel' = draw a circle; 'Kleur dit rooi in' = colour it red.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.audio: Vat die boek. Sit dit op die tafel.
options: Take the book, put it on the table
Take the pen, put it in the bag
Open the book on the table
questions.expected: Take the book, put it on the table
questions.memo: 'Vat die boek' = take the book; 'Sit dit op die tafel' = put it on the table.

questions.question: Which step comes FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what to do first.
questions.audio: Was jou hande. Eet jou kos.
questions.memo: 'Was jou hande' (wash your hands) is said first, then 'Eet jou kos' (eat your food).

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.audio: Staan op. Loop na die deur.
options: Stand up, walk to the door
Sit down, look at the door
questions.expected: Stand up, walk to the door
questions.memo: 'Staan op' = stand up; 'Loop na die deur' = walk to the door.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.audio: Maak die boek oop. Lees die storie.
options: Open the book, read the story
Close the book, draw a picture
Open the door, read the sign
questions.expected: Open the book, read the story
questions.memo: 'Maak die boek oop' = open the book; 'Lees die storie' = read the story.

questions.question: What two things were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Maak die venster toe. Sit op die mat.
options: Close the window, sit on the mat
Open the window, sit on the chair
Close the door, sit on the mat
questions.expected: Close the window, sit on the mat
questions.memo: 'Maak ... toe' = close; 'Sit op die mat' = sit on the mat.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
options: Take your pencil, draw a house
Take your pen, draw a dog
Take your book, read a story
questions.expected: Take your pencil, draw a house

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Tel die bal op. Gooi dit vir my.
options: Pick up the ball, throw it to me
Kick the ball, run to me
Pick up the book, give it to me
questions.expected: Pick up the ball, throw it to me

questions.question: Which step comes FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen. Which do you do first?
questions.audio: Drink jou melk. Borsel jou tande.
questions.memo: The first instruction was 'Drink jou melk' (drink your milk).

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Trek jou skoene aan. Loop buite toe.
options: Put on your shoes, walk outside
Take off your shoes, stay inside
Put on your hat, walk outside
questions.expected: Put on your shoes, walk outside

questions.question: Which step comes LAST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen. Which do you do last?
questions.audio: Was jou hande. Droog hulle af.
questions.memo: After washing ('Was jou hande'), the last step is 'Droog hulle af' (dry them).

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Maak die deur oop. Roep die hond.
options: Open the door, call the dog
Close the door, feed the dog
Open the window, call the cat
questions.expected: Open the door, call the dog

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Sit die boek in die sak. Gee dit vir Ma.
options: Put the book in the bag, give it to Mom
Take the book out, give it to Dad
Put the pen in the bag, give it to Mom
questions.expected: Put the book in the bag, give it to Mom
questions.memo: 'Sit ... in die sak' = put in the bag, 'Gee dit vir Ma' = give it to Mom.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Staan in 'n ry. Wag vir jou beurt.
options: Stand in a line, wait for your turn
questions.expected: Stand in a line, wait for your turn
questions.memo: 'Staan in 'n ry' = stand in a line, 'Wag vir jou beurt' = wait for your turn.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Kleur die son geel. Kleur die gras groen.
options: Colour the sun yellow, the grass green
Colour the sun red, the grass blue
questions.expected: Colour the sun yellow, the grass green
questions.memo: 'Kleur ... geel' = colour yellow, 'gras groen' = grass green.

questions.question: Which step comes FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen. Which do you do first?
questions.audio: Eet jou kos. Was jou bord.
questions.memo: First 'Eet jou kos' (eat your food), then 'Was jou bord' (wash your plate).

options: Fold the paper, draw on it

questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Pak jou speelgoed weg. Gaan slaap.
options: Pack away your toys, go to sleep
Take out your toys, play more
questions.expected: Pack away your toys, go to sleep
questions.memo: 'Pak ... weg' = pack away, 'Gaan slaap' = go to sleep.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Skryf jou naam. Trek 'n streep daaronder.
options: Write your name, draw a line under it
Write a number, draw a box
questions.expected: Write your name, draw a line under it
questions.memo: 'Skryf jou naam' = write your name, 'Trek 'n streep daaronder' = draw a line under it.

questions.question: What were you asked to do?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen, then choose what you must do.
questions.audio: Tel tot drie. Spring dan hoog.
options: Count to three, then jump high
questions.expected: Count to three, then jump high
questions.memo: 'Tel tot drie' = count to three, 'Spring dan hoog' = then jump high.

AF.G2.LUI.02.title: Identifiseer voorwerp uit beskrywing (identify object from description)
AF.G2.LUI.02.description: Listen to a simple Afrikaans description and choose the object it describes.
AF.G2.LUI.02.recovery_strategy: Re-read the description one clue at a time and rule options out clue by clue.

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is rond en rooi. Jy speel daarmee.
questions.memo: Round, red and you play with it = 'n bal (a ball).

questions.question: What animal is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit het vier bene. Dit blaf. Dit is 'n troeteldier.
questions.memo: Four legs, it barks (blaf), a pet = 'n hond (a dog).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is geel. Jy eet dit. 'n Aap hou daarvan.
questions.memo: Yellow, you eat it, a monkey likes it = 'n piesang (a banana).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit skyn in die dag. Dit is warm en geel.
questions.memo: Shines in the day, warm and yellow = die son (the sun).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Jy trek dit aan jou voete. Jy stap daarmee.
questions.memo: You put them on your feet and walk = skoene (shoes).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit het vlerke. Dit kan vlieg. Dit sing.
questions.memo: Wings + flies + sings = a bird ('n voël).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is wit. Jy drink dit. Dit kom van 'n koei.
questions.memo: White + you drink it + comes from a cow = milk (melk).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit het baie blare. Dit is hoog. Voëls sit daarin.
questions.memo: Many leaves + tall + birds sit in it = a tree ('n boom).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Jy sit daarop. Dit het vier bene.
questions.memo: You sit on it + four legs = a chair. (A bed has legs too, but you lie on it.)

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is koud en wit. Dit val in die winter.
questions.memo: Cold + white + falls in winter = snow (sneeu).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit het vier wiele. Dit ry op die pad.
questions.memo: Four wheels + drives on the road = a car. A bike has two wheels.

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is groen. Dit spring. Dit woon by die water.
questions.memo: Green + jumps + lives by water = a frog ('n padda).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Jy lees dit. Dit het baie bladsye.
questions.memo: You read it + many pages = a book ('n boek).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit skyn in die nag. Dit is in die lug.
questions.memo: Shines at night + in the sky = the moon (die maan). The sun shines in the day.

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is lank en geel. 'n Aap eet dit.
questions.memo: Long + yellow + a monkey eats it = a banana ('n piesang).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit blaf. Dit het vier bene. Dit is 'n troeteldier.
questions.memo: Barks + four legs + a pet = a dog ('n hond).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Jy trek dit oor jou kop aan. Dit hou jou warm.
questions.memo: You pull it over your head + keeps you warm = a jersey ('n trui).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is rond. Dit wys die tyd.
questions.memo: Round + shows the time = a clock/watch ('n horlosie).

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit is rooi en rond. Dit groei op 'n boom. Jy eet dit.
questions.memo: Red + round + grows on a tree + you eat it = an apple. (A ball isn't food.)

questions.question: What is being described?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the clues, then choose.
questions.audio: Dit het baie kleure. Jy sien dit ná die reën.
questions.memo: Many colours + after the rain = a rainbow ('n reënboog).

AF.G2.LUI.03.title: Beantwoord vrae oor 'n storie — gebeure in volgorde (story comprehension: events in order)
AF.G2.LUI.03.description: Listen to a short Afrikaans story and answer comprehension and ordering questions.
AF.G2.LUI.03.recovery_strategy: Re-read and pause after each event. Ask 'what happened next?' before the ordering question.

questions.question: What did Tom do FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Tom het opgestaan. Toe het hy ontbyt geëet. Daarna het hy skool toe gegaan.
questions.memo: The story says 'Tom het opgestaan' first — he got up first.

questions.question: What did Tom do LAST?
questions.audio: Tom het opgestaan. Toe het hy ontbyt geëet. Daarna het hy skool toe gegaan.
questions.memo: 'Daarna het hy skool toe gegaan' is the last event — he went to school last.

questions.question: Why was the girl happy?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Lisa het 'n present gekry. Sy was baie bly.
questions.memo: 'Lisa het 'n present gekry' — she got a present, so she was happy (bly).

questions.question: Where did the family go?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die gesin het strand toe gegaan. Hulle het in die see geswem.
questions.memo: 'strand toe gegaan' = went to the beach; they swam in the sea.

questions.question: What did the dog do after it ate?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die hond het kos geëet. Toe het hy gaan slaap.
questions.memo: 'Toe het hy gaan slaap' — after eating, the dog went to sleep.

questions.question: What happened LAST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Ben het 'n bal gevat. Hy het buite gaan speel. Toe het dit gereën.
questions.memo: The last event was 'Toe het dit gereën' (then it rained).

questions.question: What did Mia do FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Mia het kos gemaak. Sy het die tafel gedek. Toe het hulle geëet.

questions.question: Why did Mom comfort the boy?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die seun het geval. Hy het gehuil. Ma het hom getroos.
questions.memo: He fell ('het geval') and cried ('het gehuil'), so Mom comforted him.

questions.question: What did they do AFTER baking the cake?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die gesin het 'n koek gebak. Hulle het kersies opgesit. Toe het hulle gesing.
questions.memo: After baking ('gebak'), they put on candles ('kersies opgesit').

questions.question: Where did Sara go in the end?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Sara het haar tas gepak. Sy het bus toe geloop. Toe het sy skool toe gegaan.
questions.memo: In the end 'sy het skool toe gegaan' (she went to school).

questions.question: What did the dog do with the bone?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die hond het 'n been gekry. Hy het dit begrawe. Toe het hy gaan slaap.

questions.question: How did Tom feel the next day?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Tom was siek. Hy het medisyne gedrink. Die volgende dag was hy beter.
questions.memo: 'die volgende dag was hy beter' = the next day he was better.

questions.question: What washed the castle away?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die kinders het sand gegrawe. Hulle het 'n kasteel gebou. Die see het dit weggespoel.
questions.memo: 'Die see het dit weggespoel' = the sea washed it away.

questions.question: What grew?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Lisa het 'n saad geplant. Sy het dit natgemaak. 'n Blom het gegroei.
questions.memo: 'n Blom het gegroei' = a flower grew.

questions.question: What did the bird do FIRST?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die voël het takkies gevat. Sy het 'n nes gebou. Toe het sy eiers gelê.
questions.memo: First 'takkies gevat' (took twigs), then built the nest, then laid eggs.

questions.question: Why did Dad wash the car again?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Pappa het die kar gewas. Dit het vuil geword in die modder. Hy het dit weer gewas.
options: It got dirty in the mud
questions.expected: It got dirty in the mud
questions.memo: 'Dit het vuil geword in die modder' = it got dirty in the mud, so he washed it again.

questions.question: Did the cat catch the mouse?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die kat het 'n muis gesien. Sy het agter hom gehardloop. Die muis het weggekom.
questions.memo: 'Die muis het weggekom' = the mouse got away, so the cat did not catch it.

questions.question: What did they eat?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Ons het na die dieretuin gegaan. Ons het die olifante gesien. Toe het ons roomys geëet.

questions.question: Why did the boy fall?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Die seun het sy fiets gery. Hy het te vinnig gery. Hy het geval.
questions.memo: 'Hy het te vinnig gery' = he rode too fast, so he fell.

questions.question: What did they see at the end?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to the story, then answer.
questions.audio: Eers het dit gereën. Toe het die son uitgekom. Toe het ons 'n reënboog gesien.
questions.memo: After the rain and sun, 'ons het 'n reënboog gesien' (we saw a rainbow).

AF.G2.KLK.02.title: Letter-klank verhoudings (letter-sound relationships)
AF.G2.KLK.02.description: Match single Afrikaans letters to their sounds.
AF.G2.KLK.02.recovery_strategy: Show the letter, say its sound, give a key word (m -> /m/ -> mat).

questions.question: Which letter makes the /m/ sound?
questions.memo: The letter 'm' makes the /m/ sound, like in 'mat'.

questions.question: Which letter makes the /s/ sound?
questions.memo: The letter 's' makes the /s/ sound, like in 'son'.

questions.question: What sound does the letter 'v' make in Afrikaans?
questions.ruby_prompt: In Afrikaans, what sound does 'v' make?
questions.memo: In Afrikaans the letter 'v' makes an /f/ sound, like in 'vis' (fish).

questions.question: Which letter makes the /k/ sound?
questions.memo: The letter 'k' makes the /k/ sound, like in 'kat'.

questions.question: Which word starts with the letter that makes /h/?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word starts with the /h/ letter?
questions.memo: 'hond' starts with 'h', which makes the /h/ sound.

questions.question: Which letter makes the /b/ sound?
questions.memo: The letter 'b' makes the /b/ sound, as in 'bal'.

questions.question: Which letter makes the /r/ sound?
questions.memo: 'r' makes a rolled /r/ in Afrikaans, as in 'rok'.

questions.question: Which word STARTS with the /p/ sound?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: /p/. Which word starts with it?

questions.question: What sound does 'g' make in Afrikaans?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to 'goud'. What sound does 'g' make?
questions.memo: In Afrikaans 'g' makes a throaty sound from the back of the mouth, as in 'goud' (gold).

questions.question: Which word STARTS with the /l/ sound?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: /l/. Which word starts with it?

questions.question: Which letter makes the /f/ sound?
questions.memo: 'f' makes /f/, as in 'fiets'. (The letter 'v' also makes /f/ in Afrikaans.)

questions.question: What sound does 'w' make in Afrikaans?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to 'water'. What sound does 'w' make?
questions.memo: In Afrikaans 'w' makes a /v/ sound, so 'water' sounds like 'vater'.

questions.question: Which word STARTS with the /s/ sound?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: /s/. Which word starts with it?

questions.question: Which word STARTS with the /k/ sound?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: /k/. Which word starts with it?
questions.memo: 'kat' starts with /k/. In Afrikaans the letter 'k' makes the /k/ sound.

questions.question: What sound does 'j' make in Afrikaans?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen to 'ja'. What sound does 'j' make?
questions.memo: In Afrikaans 'j' makes a /y/ sound, so 'ja' sounds like 'ya'.

questions.question: Which word STARTS with the /m/ sound?
questions.ruby_prompt: Listen: /m/. Which word starts with it?

questions.question: Who is the jersey for?

questions.question: Why did everyone clap?

questions.question: Why did the baby cry?

questions.audio: Die man het 'n sambreel oopgemaak toe dit begin reën het.

questions.question: What will probably happen next?

questions.memo: 'bome' = trees: 'Daar is baie bome in die bos' = 'There are many trees in the forest'.

questions.question: Which can you count: 'boeke' or 'water'?
questions.memo: You can count books ('boeke': 1, 2, 3) but not water — water is uncountable.

questions.question: What is the plural of 'boom'?
questions.memo: The plural of 'boom' is 'bome' (one o drops, add -e).

questions.question: Which is a thing you CANNOT count?
questions.memo: You cannot count milk ('melk') — it has no plural. You can count apples and dogs.

questions.question: Finish: 'Daar is baie ___ in die mandjie.' (apples)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which is the plural of 'appel'? Daar is baie ___.

questions.question: What is the plural of 'kind'?
questions.memo: The plural of 'kind' is 'kinders' — a special one (adds -ers).

questions.question: What is the plural of 'man'?
questions.memo: The plural of 'man' is 'manne' (double n, add -e).

questions.question: Which word names a THING (a noun)?
questions.ruby_prompt: Which word is a noun (a thing)?
questions.memo: 'tafel' (table) is a noun — a thing. 'vinnig' describes; 'loop' is an action.

questions.question: Finish: 'Sy het twee ___.' (eyes)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which is the plural of 'oog'? Sy het twee ___.
questions.memo: The plural of 'oog' is 'oë' — a special one.

questions.question: Which is uncountable (no plural)?
questions.memo: You cannot count sugar ('suiker'). You can count chairs and pens.

questions.question: Finish: 'Daar is baie ___ in die see.' (fish, plural)
questions.ruby_prompt: Which is the plural of 'vis'? Daar is baie ___.
questions.memo: The plural of 'vis' is 'visse' (double s, add -e).

questions.question: What is the plural of 'blom'?
questions.memo: The plural of 'blom' is 'blomme' (double m, add -e).

questions.question: Which word is a noun (a naming word)?
questions.memo: 'hond' (dog) is a noun. 'groot' describes; 'hardloop' is an action.

questions.question: 'Sand' and 'water' are special because you...?
questions.memo: 'Sand' and 'water' are uncountable — you can't say 'two sands'. You measure them instead.
